name: @tvlm/android
description: Capacitor Android app (phone / tablet on the same Wi-Fi as the box). Two brands x two stores = four gradle variants, one signing key. Native: the AdbSocket Kotlin plugin (TCP connect, Wireless-debugging pairing/TLS).

scripts.sync:launcher: cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher pnpm --filter @tvlm/web build:launcher && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher npx cap sync android
